# WP7.3.3 fictional owner-review projects

These are disposable current-format5 projects, generated by
`node tests/wp733/export-fixtures.mjs` and validated by the existing parser.
They contain no real owner data. Save/export a real plan before replacement.

Follow the [owner runbook](../../../docs/qa/wp7-3-3/OWNER-RUNBOOK.md).
After each import, set the **PA As-of** from `manifest.json`:

| Fixtures | PA As-of |
| --- | --- |
| late, before, absorbed, leaf, tied, driver, started, blocked, reopened, conflict, missing-reference | 2026-11-06 |
| future | 2026-11-04 |
| on-time, early | 2026-11-02 |
| weekend | 2026-11-07 |

`before.json` starts T1 In Progress so confirmation resolves required Unknown
readiness. `late.json` is the corresponding Nov6 completion with historical
Nov2 reference. The separate `absorbed.json` root startsNov9 and endsNov10,
absorbing T2's shifted Nov9 finish. Weekend actuals deliberately use a
nonworking date; on-time/early/missing-reference variants test precision.

Baseline, progress history and source tasks are normal existing-format facts.
No rendered extension, derived PA endpoint, relationship, R glyph or PA
preference is added to the file. Scripted effective/recorded dates can differ
from the reviewer's local today.
